text:
ITEM 1: Dark reddish-brown glossy caramelized bite-sized pieces, smooth firm skin — likely teriyaki or glazed chicken/meatballs, or glazed sweet potato cubes. Glossy caramelized cubes with firm smooth skin fit glazed chicken pieces best. Chicken thigh cooked: water ~58, protein ~24, fat ~12, carb ~4 (glaze adds sugar, so carb ~6, reduce water slightly).

ITEM 2: Mixed greens with burgundy leaves and red bits — likely mixed salad greens (lettuce, radicchio) with cherry tomato or red cabbage. Water ~93, protein ~1.5, fat ~0.3, carb ~3.

ITEM 3: Shredded pale golden starchy mass with browned crispy edges, crumbly and dry — likely hash browns or shredded fried potato (rösti). Fried potato: water ~50, protein ~3, fat ~12, carb ~30.

ITEM 1 | Glazed chicken (teriyaki-style) | 55 | 22 | 11 | 8
ITEM 2 | Mixed salad greens | 93 | 1.5 | 0.3 | 3
ITEM 3 | Shredded fried potato (hash brown/rösti) | 48 | 3 | 12 | 30
